description: Shiploom default-deny pack (MASTER_SPEC 22): destructive and irreversible actions are denied or require recorded human approval. Evaluated by cli/policy.py; orchestrator policy gates enforce it (deny -> exit 3).

rules.message: destructive action denied by default policy (no override path in MVP)
deployments require a recorded human approval
protected-branch merges require a recorded human approval
spend and provisioning require a recorded human approval
read-only and local verification actions are permitted
